privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Zaffa ("Zaffa", "we", "us") collects when you use zaffa.ai or any related service, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices you have. It applies to clients planning an event, planners and vendors offering their services, and visitors to our public pages. By using Zaffa you accept the practices described here.
privacy.controller: Zaffa is operated from Paris, France. For privacy questions, data subject requests, or to reach our designated privacy contact, email privacy@zaffa.ai. If we work with a separate data protection officer in your jurisdiction, we will name them in this section.
privacy.collect: We collect three categories of information: information you give us directly, information generated as you use the platform, and information from third parties that help us run it.
privacy.collect_item_account: Account details: name, email, phone, profile photo, role (client / planner / vendor), preferred language, time zone, and — for professionals — business name, license / commercial registration numbers, bank or wallet details used for payouts.
privacy.collect_item_event: Event details you create: title, type, date, venue, budget, guest count, style preferences, AI prompts, and any uploaded inspiration, mood boards, or generated designs.
privacy.collect_item_payments: Payment information: amounts, currency, payer, payee, payment schedule, refund and dispute history, and Stripe identifiers (customer, payment intent, charge, refund). Card numbers, CVV, and bank details are handled by Stripe under its own privacy policy and are never stored on Zaffa servers.
privacy.collect_item_messages: Messages, files, and proposals exchanged through the platform between clients, planners, and vendors. We may scan messages for fraud, spam, and policy violations.
privacy.collect_item_usage: Usage and device data: pages visited, features used, referrer, approximate IP-based location, browser and device metadata, crash reports, and timestamps. We collect this through Vercel Analytics, Vercel Speed Insights, PostHog (product analytics, feature flags, optional session replay), and — when enabled — Sentry (error monitoring).
privacy.collect_item_cookies: Cookies and similar technologies: a strictly necessary session cookie for authentication, a small set of preference cookies (language, theme), and analytics cookies. Where required by law, non-essential cookies only run after consent.
privacy.use: We use the information described above only for the purposes set out below. The legal bases we rely on are contract performance (to provide what you signed up for), our legitimate interest (to keep the platform safe and to improve it), legal obligation (tax, accounting, anti-fraud), and your consent (for optional emails, AI processing of sensitive prompts, and non-essential cookies).
privacy.use_item_match: To connect clients with planners and vendors that match the event brief, including AI-assisted matching, design generation, and prospect qualification.
privacy.use_item_payments: To process payments, payouts, refunds, and disputes through Stripe, and to keep accurate financial records.
privacy.use_item_safety: To prevent fraud, abuse, account takeovers, and unauthorized access, and to enforce our Terms of Service.
privacy.use_item_emails: To send transactional emails about your account, events, payments, and messages. Marketing or product update emails are sent only if you opt in and you can unsubscribe from any email footer or from the in-app notification preferences page.
privacy.use_item_analytics: To understand how the product is used, A/B test changes, prioritise improvements, and reproduce bugs. Aggregated, non-identifying analytics may be retained indefinitely.
privacy.ai: Some features (venue designer, mood boards, prompt suggestions, vendor outreach drafts) send the prompts and reference images you provide to AI providers, currently OpenAI and — for video — fal.ai or compatible providers, under agreements that prohibit the provider from training their models on your data. Generated outputs are stored against your account and can be deleted from the relevant page. Do not enter information you would not want included in a generated design.
privacy.share: We share the minimum amount of data needed to operate the service. Sharing falls into four buckets:
privacy.share_item_processors: Service providers who process data on our instructions: Supabase (database, authentication, realtime), Stripe (payments and refunds), Cloudinary (image and video storage), Resend (transactional email), Upstash (rate-limiting, queues, cache), OpenAI and OpenRouter (AI generation), Vercel (hosting, analytics, speed insights), PostHog (product analytics, feature flags), Sentry (error monitoring), and Cloudflare (edge proxy). Each is bound by a data processing agreement.
privacy.share_item_other_users: Other users you choose to interact with: a planner you message, a vendor you engage, an admin reviewing a dispute. We never share your private contact details outside the platform without your action.
privacy.share_item_legal: Authorities and legal counsel when we are required to comply with law, a valid court order, or to protect our rights, your safety, or the safety of others.
privacy.share_item_business: A successor entity in the unlikely event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale. We will notify users and give them a chance to opt out where the law requires it.
privacy.share_no_sale: We do not sell personal information and do not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising.
privacy.transfers: Some of our processors are located outside the European Economic Area — primarily in the United Kingdom and the United States. Where we transfer personal data outside your country we rely on the recipient's adequacy status, Standard Contractual Clauses, or another approved transfer mechanism, and apply additional technical safeguards (encryption in transit and at rest).
privacy.retention: We keep account data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account we mark it for deletion immediately and remove personal data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it for legal, tax, accounting, or anti-fraud reasons (typically completed payment records for up to 10 years). Server logs are retained for up to 90 days. Anonymised analytics may be kept indefinitely.
privacy.security: We protect data with TLS in transit, encryption at rest where supported, role-based access controls, audit logs on admin tools, regular dependency upgrades, and least-privilege secrets management. No system is perfectly secure — if you believe your account has been compromised, contact security@zaffa.ai immediately.
privacy.rights: Depending on where you live (notably under the EU/UK GDPR or similar laws) you may have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to its processing, withdraw consent, receive a portable copy, and lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority — for users in France, the CNIL (cnil.fr). You can exercise most of these rights yourself: profile updates and account deletion live in Settings, and any email contains an unsubscribe link. For other requests, email privacy@zaffa.ai and we will respond within 30 days.
privacy.children: Zaffa is not directed at people under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact privacy@zaffa.ai and we will delete it.
privacy.changes: We will update this policy as the product evolves. Material changes will be highlighted on this page and, where appropriate, notified by email or in-app banner before they take effect. The "last updated" date at the top always reflects the most recent revision.
privacy.contact: Privacy questions: privacy@zaffa.ai. General support: hello@zaffa.ai. Postal address available on request.

terms.intro: These Terms of Service form a binding agreement between you and Zaffa. By creating an account, browsing zaffa.ai, or using any feature of the platform, you accept these Terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service. Capitalised terms not defined here have the meaning given in our Privacy Policy.

"Client" means a user planning an event. "Planner" means a professional offering planning services. "Vendor" means a professional offering individual services (catering, photography, flowers, etc.). "Professional" means a Planner or Vendor.
terms.accounts: You must be 18 or older and able to enter into a binding contract under the laws of your country to use Zaffa. You agree to provide accurate information, keep it up to date, choose a strong password, enable two-factor authentication where offered, and accept responsibility for any activity under your account. You may not share your account or use someone else's. We may require additional identity or business verification before you can publish a profile or receive payouts.
terms.marketplace: Zaffa is a platform that connects Clients with independent Planners and Vendors. Professionals are independent contractors, not employees, agents, or franchisees of Zaffa. We do our best to verify professionals — including reviewing their portfolio, contact details, and (where required) commercial registration — but verification is not a guarantee of quality, fitness for purpose, or legal compliance. You remain responsible for evaluating any party you engage and for the contracts you enter into with them.
terms.professional_obligations: If you offer services on Zaffa, you agree that the information on your profile (services, prices, availability, portfolio, reviews) is accurate and your own work or properly licensed; that you hold any licences, permits, and insurance required to do business in your jurisdiction; that you respond to client briefs and messages within a reasonable time and honour the proposals you accept; that you collect and remit any taxes due on your earnings; and that you do not solicit clients to transact off-platform to avoid platform fees during the engagement period.
terms.payments: Clients pay through Stripe Checkout. Zaffa is the merchant of record on platform transactions and charges a platform fee disclosed before payment. Net amounts (gross minus platform fee minus payment processing fees) are recorded against the professional's balance and paid out on a manual schedule, typically every 7 days, subject to identity verification, dispute holds, and minimum payout thresholds. Stripe's terms apply in addition to these Terms for any payment processed through it. Currency conversion, where applicable, is performed at the rate Stripe applies on the day of the transaction.
terms.refunds: Cancellation and refund eligibility depend on the agreement between Client and Professional and on the cancellation policy displayed before payment. Zaffa will issue refunds on the original payment method when (a) both parties agree, (b) a dispute resolution finds in favour of a refund, or (c) refund is required by law. Refund requests outside the agreed cancellation window are not guaranteed. Platform fees may be retained on partial refunds at our discretion. Where a refund relates to fraud or chargeback, Stripe's processes apply.
terms.disputes: If a Client and Professional disagree about delivery or quality, please try to resolve it directly through the platform messaging first. If you cannot, either party may escalate to support@zaffa.ai with evidence; Zaffa will mediate in good faith but is not obligated to act as an arbitrator. Where a Stripe payment dispute (chargeback) is opened, related funds are held until the dispute resolves and the issuing bank's decision is final.

Subject to the AI provider's terms, you may use the outputs for your own event. Zaffa makes no warranty that an AI output is original, copyright-clear, or fit for any particular purpose; you are responsible for clearing rights in any third-party imagery you upload as a reference and for reviewing outputs before using them publicly. terms.termination: You may close your account at any time from Settings, subject to a 14-day grace period during which the closure can be reversed. We may suspend or terminate any account at any time, with or without notice, if it violates these Terms, exposes us or other users to legal or financial risk, or remains inactive for an extended period. contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: We aim to reply within one business day.
contact.intro: Whether you're planning an event, applying as a planner or vendor, or have a press inquiry — send us a message below or use one of the dedicated channels. We'll route it to the right person.

about.title: Zaffa, in one paragraph
about.subtitle: A small team, an opinionated product.
about.p1: Zaffa started in Cairo, where planning a wedding — even a small one — is still a WhatsApp-spreadsheet ordeal. Vendors quote inconsistently, planners juggle clients in a notebook, and couples have no real way to see what's possible without flipping through hundreds of unsorted Instagram posts. We built the platform we wished we had.
about.p2: Our product gives couples a curated venue designer, a marketplace of vetted planners, and a single thread that connects them with vendors and tracks money end-to-end. Planners get a back-office that handles proposals, vendor engagements, and payouts so they can focus on the night itself.
about.p3: We're headquartered in Paris and partner with planners and vendors in every region we open. If you'd like to be part of the platform — as a planner, vendor, or partner — please reach out via the contact page.

Screenshots help — feel free to email them to support@zaffa.ai with the same subject line we send back to you.
reportBug.diagnosticsTitle: What we'll send with your report
reportBug.diagnosticsBody: We attach the page you were on and your browser's user-agent string so we can reproduce the issue. We do not capture your password, payment details, or other people's messages.

marketing.howAria: How Zaffa works in three steps
marketing.howSubtitle: Before any of the planning, get a real picture of your day — free, in about thirty seconds. We take it from there.
marketing.howStep1Title: Pick the photos that move you.
marketing.howStep1Body: Drop in your Pinterest finds, screenshots, anything that captures the feeling you want — for the venue, the table, the florals, the lighting. There's no wrong answer.
marketing.howStep2Title: Choose the colors of your day.
marketing.howStep2Body: Build a five-color palette that holds the mood — cream, petal, rose, amber, whatever sings to you. The AI uses it as the through-line for everything that follows.
marketing.howStep3Title: Let the AI weave it together.
marketing.howStep3Body: In about 30 seconds, Zaffa renders a single photoreal scene of your venue — your inspirations and your palette, stitched into one coherent vision instead of a dozen mismatched references.
marketing.howScreenshotPlaceholderBody: Drop the matching screenshot at this path and it'll appear here automatically.
marketing.conciergeTitle: So what do we actually do?
marketing.conciergeSubtitle: Short answer: the whole thing. Longer answer, below.
marketing.conciergePillar1Title: We find you the right planner.
marketing.conciergePillar1Body: Not whoever's free that weekend — the one who fits your budget, your taste, and the day you've got in your head. We've already vetted them.
marketing.conciergePillar2Body: Chasing vendors, fixing the mix-ups, the awkward conversations about money. That's ours, not yours.
marketing.conciergePillar3Title: We only send you people we'd use ourselves.
marketing.conciergePillar3Body: Every venue and vendor is checked before it reaches you. No guessing who's actually any good.
marketing.shareSubtitle: Every pack ships with two ways to share — a private microsite and a printable lookbook PDF — so your mom, your bridesmaids, and every planner you talk to all see the exact same vision.
marketing.shareMicrositeBody: Renders, mood board, palette, your notes — all on one page at zaffa.ai/v/your-name. Send a single link to the family group chat or keep it unlisted; your call.
marketing.shareMicrositeBullet2: Public to the gallery or unlisted — toggle anytime
marketing.shareLookbookBody: A polished PDF with a cover, a categorized mood board, every render, your palette, and your style notes — designed like a magazine spread, not a screenshot dump.
marketing.shareLookbookBullet1: Email it to any planner before the first call
marketing.shareLookbookBullet2: Print it for the meeting table — no more guesswork
marketing.beginSubtitle: Pick a palette, drop in your inspiration, render the room — the first scene is free. From there, we take over: matching you with the right planner, sourcing the vendors that fit, and turning your vision into your actual wedding day.
marketing.beginCtaHint: No card required for the first look · paid packs unlock more renders & a printable lookbook
marketing.footerBlurb: One team for the whole wedding — the planning, the venue, the vendors, and the hundred things nobody warned you about. Based in Paris, working wherever your wedding is.

authCta.loggedInBody: Continue planning your perfect celebration from your dashboard.

wholeWedding.aria: The Whole Wedding — our full-service plan
wholeWedding.title: Or let us run the whole thing.
wholeWedding.tagline: One team runs your whole wedding — every vendor found, booked and managed — for one price agreed before anything starts.
wholeWedding.bullet1: We find everyone — planner, venue, photographer, decor, flowers — and only put people in front of you we'd book for our own family.
wholeWedding.bullet2: You choose from two or three real options per thing, with real prices. Not a whole market to search.
wholeWedding.bullet3: One agreement and one point of contact. We hold the schedule, chase the vendors, and tell you what's due and when.
wholeWedding.bullet4: We already know what things should cost, and we book at our prices — not the price that appears the moment someone hears the word “wedding”.
wholeWedding.bullet5: One person you can call, from the first conversation to the wedding day itself.
wholeWedding.priceParagraph: Eighty guests in Cairo and three hundred in Dubai are not the same wedding, so we don't pretend one price fits both. What we do instead is publish ours. A flat fee for running your whole wedding, set by the size of the day and nothing else, so you know our number before you ever speak to us. Your venue, your caterer, your photographer are paid by you, at the price we booked them at.
wholeWedding.reassurance: You make the decisions. We make the calls.
wholeWedding.reassuranceLong: You'll still choose everything — the venue, the dress, the flowers. You just won't be the one chasing it, checking it, or lying awake wondering whether you paid too much.
wholeWedding.ctaHint: One conversation, then a fixed price. No card, no obligation.
wholeWedding.covers: planner | venue | photographer | decor | flowers | catering | music | invitations | hair & makeup | transport | the schedule | the chasing

wholeWedding.card1: Every vendor found, booked and managed
wholeWedding.card2: Two or three real options per thing
wholeWedding.card3: Booked at our rates, not wedding rates

pricing.metaDescription: A flat fee to run your whole wedding, published per market. You pay your vendors directly, at the price we booked.
pricing.title: Here is our number.
pricing.subtitle: One flat fee to run the whole wedding. Set by the size of your day, published before you call us, and unchanged after.
pricing.capNote: Never more than {amount}, whatever the wedding.
pricing.unpricedBody: We work wherever the wedding is. The rule is the same everywhere — one flat fee, in the range planners charge the world over — and you get your number in writing after one call.
pricing.vendorNote: Vendor costs are not included and never pass through us. You pay your venue, your caterer and your photographer directly, at the price we booked them at.
pricing.exampleSetup: A wedding in Dubai. 150 guests. You're comfortable spending {amount}.
pricing.exampleFee: That's the second band, so our fee is {amount} — about 11.8% of what you're spending, and you knew it before you called.
pricing.exampleVendors: The {amount} goes to your venue, your caterer, your photographer, your florist — from you, not through us, at the price we booked.
pricing.exampleSplit: Most couples pay part of our fee to start and the rest at a point you agree with us. Whatever the split, it's written down before you pay anything.
pricing.guaranteeTitle: Our fee, and only our fee
pricing.guaranteeBody: Vendor costs are paid by you, straight to the vendors — that money never passes through us, so it isn't ours to give back. What we guarantee is our own work. Your plan has milestones with dates on them, you get that list before you pay us anything, and if we miss one without agreeing the change with you first, the part of our fee covering that stage is yours to reclaim. No form, no window to miss. You ask, we send it back.
pricing.weekSubtitle: Nine stages, in the order they happen.
pricing.week1Body: How you want the day to feel, how many people, and the number you're comfortable with. You leave the call with our fee in writing.
pricing.week2Body: Two or three real venues, with real prices and real availability. Not a market to search.
pricing.week3Body: Venue, catering, photography, booked. They set everything else, and they're the ones that run out.

admin.depthHelp: How aggressively to fetch — deeper = more API calls + more results.

depthHint.quick: Fast preview — single query per source, no expansion. ~10 web · ~18 IG (1 hashtag) · ~50 TikTok · 15 FB · 20 directory.
depthHint.standard: Balanced default — single query per source, no expansion. Same per-call ceilings as quick, just higher dataset caps. ~20 web · ~18 IG (1 hashtag) · ~50 TikTok · 30 FB · 40 directory (2 pages).
depthHint.deep: Maximum coverage — GPT generates extra query variants and we union the results. Tavily: 4 variants × 20 = up to 100. IG: 5 related hashtags in a single Apify run (~90 posts → ~30-50 unique creators, since Apify's free tier caps each hashtag at one page). TikTok: 4 extra search queries. Facebook: 4 extra search queries (4 separate runs). Directories: walk 5 pages of pagination. Costs ~5× a standard run.
